title: Red Hat Security Advisory: Red Hat Hardened Images RPMs bug fix and enhancement update
description: Red Hat has issued a security advisory for Red Hat Hardened Images RPMs, including multiple ruby3.4 and rubygem3.4 packages. The update addresses a critical vulnerability identified as CVE-2026-132825, related to CWE-787 (out-of-bounds write). This advisory provides updated RPM packages to fix the issue. No known exploits are reported in the wild. The advisory does not specify affected product versions or detailed impact scenarios beyond the critical severity classification.
